articles.title: Meet the Likweli: A New Monkey with Orange Lips and a Roar
articles.summary: Scientists discovered a new monkey species in the Congo with orange lips and spiky hair. It's only the fifth new African monkey in 75 years. The Likweli lives in small groups and faces threats from hunting.

articles.title: Celine Dion Returns to the Stage After Rare Illness: 'I Made a Promise'
articles.summary: Celine Dion performed in Paris on September 12, 2026, nearly four years after revealing her stiff person syndrome diagnosis. She cried on stage and told fans, 'I made a promise to come back.'

articles.title: Ameen Nayfeh's 'Jo of Montreal': A Rare Feel-Good Family Film from West Asia
articles.summary: Palestinian director Ameen Nayfeh made 'Jo of Montreal,' a family film about a boy stranded in a Jordanian village. He faced pushback for not making a film about Palestine, but wanted to give kids hope.
